SMALL CLAIMS CALENDAR OF FEB-27-2023 - TAKEN UNDER SUBMISSION AS OF FEB-27-2023 BY JUDGE PANG LY. PLAINTIFF ABBY VAN SOEST IS PRESENT. DEFENDANT SF MULTIFAMILY V PROPERTY OWNER, LLC IS NOT PRESENT. NO EXHIBITS RETAINED. JUDGE PRO TEM: PANG LY; CLERK: D. AU. NOT REPORTED. (D506)
SMALL CLAIMS HEARING OF FEB-27-2023 - JUDGMENT.

THE COURT HAS ORDERED THE FOLLOWING JUDGMENT ENTERED: IT IS ADJUDGED THAT PLAINTIFF VAN SOEST, ABBY RECOVER FROM DEFENDANT SF MULTIFAMILY V PROPERTY OWNER, LLC $5,721.15 PRINCIPAL, $110.00 COSTS, TOTAL JUDGMENT $5,831.15, PLAINTIFF ESTABLISHED THERE WERE A RAT INFESTATION THAT IS GOOD FAITH BASIS FOR THE CONSTRUCTIVE EVICTION. STAY OF EXECUTION 30 DAYS NO EXHIBITS FILED
ACKNOWLEDGMENT OF SATISFACTION OF JUDGMENT, FULLY SATISFIED, AS TO DEFENDANT SF MULTIFAMILY V PROPERTY OWNER, LLC
